NumericalGlobalEnsemble.description: Physics-based numerical global ensemble forecast model.

NumericalGlobalDeterministic.description: Physics-based numerical global deterministic forecast model.

Reanalysis.description: Retrospective analysis produced by assimilating observations.

Analysis.description: Objective analysis at the initialisation time (lead 0).

Other.description: A class not covered above; MODEL_ID identifies the producer's model.

EmpiricalClimatology.description: Empirical climatological model evaluated at VALID_TIME_MS from geophysical indices, with no forecast run (pair with TIME_BASIS ValidTimeOnly).

Member.description: One perturbed ensemble member; MEMBER_INDEX selects it.

Percentile.description: Ensemble percentile; PERCENTILE holds the rank in [0, 100].

ProbabilityAboveThreshold.description: Probability that the variable exceeds THRESHOLD_VALUE, in [0, 1].

ProbabilityBelowThreshold.description: Probability that the variable falls below THRESHOLD_VALUE, in [0, 1].

Unspecified.description: The source does not identify a member or ensemble statistic. A blended point-forecast product must not be labelled as one deterministic run.
VARIABLE_NAME carries the producer's own variable name.

Temperature2m.description: Air temperature at 2 m above ground, kelvin.

DewpointTemperature2m.description: Dew-point temperature at 2 m above ground, kelvin.

WindU10m.description: Eastward wind component at 10 m above ground, m/s.

WindV10m.description: Northward wind component at 10 m above ground, m/s.

WindSpeed10m.description: Wind speed at 10 m above ground, m/s.

WindU100m.description: Eastward wind component at 100 m above ground, m/s.

WindV100m.description: Northward wind component at 100 m above ground, m/s.

WindSpeed100m.description: Wind speed at 100 m above ground, m/s.

SurfaceSolarRadiationDownwards.description: Surface downward shortwave radiation accumulated over ACCUMULATION_HOURS, J/m^2.

TotalSkyDirectSolarRadiationAtSurface.description: Total-sky direct shortwave radiation at the surface accumulated over ACCUMULATION_HOURS, J/m^2.

TotalPrecipitation.description: Total precipitation accumulated over ACCUMULATION_HOURS, metres of water equivalent.

TotalPrecipitationSatelliteBlended.description: Total precipitation trained against a satellite-blended precipitation analysis, accumulated over ACCUMULATION_HOURS, metres of water equivalent.

TotalPrecipitationExperimental.description: Experimental total precipitation product, accumulated over ACCUMULATION_HOURS, metres of water equivalent.

Geopotential.description: Geopotential on a pressure level, m^2/s^2.

Temperature.description: Air temperature on a pressure level, kelvin.

SpecificHumidity.description: Specific humidity on a pressure level, kg/kg.

WindU.description: Eastward wind component on a pressure level, m/s.

WindV.description: Northward wind component on a pressure level, m/s.

VerticalVelocity.description: Vertical velocity on a pressure level, Pa/s.

GeopotentialHeight.description: Geopotential height, geopotential metres (gpm): the height a producer such as GFS publishes on pressure levels and at the tropopause. Distinct from Geopotential (m^2/s^2); a consumer never relabels one as the other.

BrightnessTemperature.description: Brightness temperature a radiometer channel measured, kelvin: the temperature of a black body emitting the observed radiance at CHANNEL_WAVELENGTH_UM. At LEVEL_KIND TopOfAtmosphere.

Reflectance.description: Top-of-atmosphere bidirectional reflectance factor of a solar channel at CHANNEL_WAVELENGTH_UM, dimensionless (1 = a white Lambertian surface under the same illumination), not corrected for the solar zenith angle unless VARIABLE_NAME says so. Missing at night.

CloudMask.description: Categorical cloud mask of a satellite retrieval: 0 clear, 1 probably clear, 2 probably cloudy, 3 cloudy. Units "1". A cell resampled from several source pixels carries their mean, so fractional values are the average category, not a new class.

CloudPhase.description: Categorical thermodynamic phase at the cloud top: 0 clear, 1 liquid water, 2 supercooled liquid water, 3 mixed, 4 ice, 5 unknown. Units "1". Resampled cells carry the category of the source pixel nearest the cell centre.

CloudOpticalDepth.description: Cloud optical depth at CHANNEL_WAVELENGTH_UM, dimensionless.

HeightAboveGround.description: Fixed height above ground; LEVEL_VALUE in metres.

MeanSeaLevel.description: Mean sea level; LEVEL_VALUE is unused.

EntireAtmosphere.description: Whole atmospheric column; LEVEL_VALUE is unused.

TopOfAtmosphere.description: Top of atmosphere; LEVEL_VALUE is unused.

Tropopause.description: The producer's diagnosed tropopause; LEVEL_VALUE is unused. Its height is a GeopotentialHeight field at this level, never implied by a pressure.

HeightAboveEllipsoid.description: Geometric height above the reference ellipsoid; LEVEL_VALUE in metres. For fields defined at altitude rather than on pressure levels (for example the upper atmosphere).

CloudTop.description: The top of the cloud a satellite retrieval saw in each cell; the level varies from cell to cell and LEVEL_VALUE is unused. The height itself is a GeopotentialHeight field at this level (a Temperature field gives the cloud-top temperature), never implied by the level.

Accumulated.description: Sum over the ACCUMULATION_HOURS ending at VALID_TIME_MS.

Averaged.description: Mean over the ACCUMULATION_HOURS ending at VALID_TIME_MS.

Maximum.description: Maximum over the ACCUMULATION_HOURS ending at VALID_TIME_MS.

Minimum.description: Minimum over the ACCUMULATION_HOURS ending at VALID_TIME_MS.

RegularLatLon.description: Regular latitude-longitude grid with constant DLAT / DLON.

InlineFloat32.description: Samples are inline in VALUES (NLAT * NLON <= 1,048,576 cells).

ContentAddressedChunk.description: Samples are a content-addressed chunk named by CHUNK_CID; CHUNK_DTYPE / CHUNK_CODECS describe its layout. Used above 1,048,576 cells.

InlineQuantizedUint16.description: Samples are inline in QUANTIZED_U16 as unsigned 16-bit codes: value = ADD_OFFSET + SCALE_FACTOR * code; code 65535 marks a missing cell. Same cell limit and order as InlineFloat32. VALUE_MIN / VALUE_MAX are decoded values.

InlineQuantizedUint8.description: Samples are inline in QUANTIZED_U8 as unsigned 8-bit codes: value = ADD_OFFSET + SCALE_FACTOR * code; code 255 marks a missing cell. Same cell limit and order as InlineFloat32.

InlineEncodedChunk.description: Samples are quantized codes as InlineQuantizedUint16 / InlineQuantizedUint8 (CHUNK_DTYPE "uint16" or "uint8"; value = ADD_OFFSET + SCALE_FACTOR * code; the all-ones code marks a missing cell), inline in QUANTIZED_U8 as a chunk encoded by CHUNK_CODECS. Same cell limit and order as InlineFloat32; CHUNK_BYTE_LENGTH is the chunk's length.

RealTimeExperimental.description: Real-time or future-valid data offered under an experimental real-time terms-of-use; not an official warning; redistribution limited per LICENSE_URL.

Historical.description: Data older than the producer's real-time window, offered under an open attribution licence named by LICENSE_URL.

OpenAttribution.description: Data of any valid time offered under an open attribution licence named by LICENSE_URL. Unlike Historical, this makes no claim about age or a producer's real-time window. API access terms can be more restrictive than the licence on the resulting data and must be checked separately.

Initialization.description: INIT_TIME_MS names a run; VALID_TIME_MS = INIT_TIME_MS + LEAD_HOURS * 3,600,000. This is the existing WXF convention.

ValidTimeOnly.description: Only VALID_TIME_MS is known. The source may blend runs or omit their initialization times. INIT_TIME_MS, LEAD_HOURS and HORIZON_HOURS MUST be omitted; their zero defaults do not mean a run in 1970, zero lead, or zero horizon. RETRIEVED_AT is not a substitute for initialization.

WXFGrid.description:
Regular grid the samples are laid out on. Samples are row-major with
latitude as the outer index: cell (i, j) for 0 <= i < NLAT, 0 <= j < NLON
sits at VALUES[i * NLON + j] and is centred at
(LAT0 + i * DLAT, LON0 + j * DLON). DLAT is negative when rows run north
to south. Longitudes are in [-180, 180) or [0, 360) exactly as the
producer publishes them; a consumer normalises.

RegularLatLon.description: Regular latitude-longitude grid with constant DLAT / DLON.

LAT0.description: Latitude of the first row's cell centre, degrees north.

LON0.description: Longitude of the first column's cell centre, degrees east.

PERIODIC_LON.description: Whether the last column wraps to the first (global grid).

WXF.description:
Weather Forecast Field - One variable, level, member and valid time on a
regular grid.

FIELD_ID.description:
Stable identifier of the whole field this record belongs to; equal
across all tiles of one (producer, init, member, variable, level, lead).

INIT_TIME_MS.description:
Initialisation (analysis) time of the run, Unix milliseconds UTC.
Present only for TIME_BASIS Initialization.

LEAD_HOURS.description:
Forecast lead from INIT_TIME_MS, hours. Present only for TIME_BASIS
Initialization.

VALID_TIME_MS.description:
Time the field is valid at, Unix milliseconds UTC
(INIT_TIME_MS + LEAD_HOURS * 3.6e6 when TIME_BASIS is Initialization).

HORIZON_HOURS.description:
Maximum lead the run was integrated to, hours (e.g. 360 for a synoptic
cycle, 48 for an interim cycle). Omitted for ValidTimeOnly.

GRID.description: Grid geometry of this record's samples (of this tile when tiled).

TILE_INDEX.description: Zero-based tile index within FIELD_ID; 0 for an untiled field.

TILE_COUNT.description: Number of tiles FIELD_ID was split into; 1 for an untiled field.

InlineFloat32.description: Samples are inline in VALUES (NLAT * NLON <= 1,048,576 cells).

ContentAddressedChunk.description: Samples are a content-addressed chunk named by CHUNK_CID; CHUNK_DTYPE / CHUNK_CODECS describe its layout. Used above 1,048,576 cells.

InlineQuantizedUint16.description: Samples are inline in QUANTIZED_U16 as unsigned 16-bit codes: value = ADD_OFFSET + SCALE_FACTOR * code; code 65535 marks a missing cell. Same cell limit and order as InlineFloat32. VALUE_MIN / VALUE_MAX are decoded values.

InlineQuantizedUint8.description: Samples are inline in QUANTIZED_U8 as unsigned 8-bit codes: value = ADD_OFFSET + SCALE_FACTOR * code; code 255 marks a missing cell. Same cell limit and order as InlineFloat32.

InlineEncodedChunk.description: Samples are quantized codes as InlineQuantizedUint16 / InlineQuantizedUint8 (CHUNK_DTYPE "uint16" or "uint8"; value = ADD_OFFSET + SCALE_FACTOR * code; the all-ones code marks a missing cell), inline in QUANTIZED_U8 as a chunk encoded by CHUNK_CODECS. Same cell limit and order as InlineFloat32; CHUNK_BYTE_LENGTH is the chunk's length.

CHUNK_CID.description:
Content identifier of the sample chunk when VALUES_ENCODING is
ContentAddressedChunk.

CHUNK_DTYPE.description:
Element type of the chunk (e.g. "float32", "float16"; "uint16" or "uint8"
for InlineEncodedChunk).

CHUNK_CODECS.description:
Codec chain applied to the chunk, outermost last (e.g. "bytes",
"zstd"). For InlineEncodedChunk, applied in order to the codes in the
order of VALUES (little-endian elements):
"delta"   each element less the one before it, the first kept,
wrapping in the element type;
"zigzag"  each element read as signed in its type and mapped to
unsigned, n >= 0 to 2n and n < 0 to -2n - 1;
"shuffle" the elements' bytes grouped by significance, every
element's least significant byte first.
Decoding applies the inverses from the last back.

VALUE_MIN.description:
Minimum sample over the field (after decoding); statistics for display
scaling without touching the chunk.

VALUE_MAX.description: Maximum sample over the field (after decoding).

MISSING_COUNT.description: Number of cells with a missing value.

ORIGIN_ID.description:
Upstream publisher the field was retrieved from, as a host name or
stable identifier.

DATASET_ID.description:
Stable dataset identifier within the origin (e.g. a bucket, collection
or table name).

SOURCE_URL.description: Upstream URL or object path the field was retrieved from.

RETRIEVED_AT.description: Unix milliseconds UTC when the field was retrieved from the origin.

RealTimeExperimental.description: Real-time or future-valid data offered under an experimental real-time terms-of-use; not an official warning; redistribution limited per LICENSE_URL.

Historical.description: Data older than the producer's real-time window, offered under an open attribution licence named by LICENSE_URL.

OpenAttribution.description: Data of any valid time offered under an open attribution licence named by LICENSE_URL. Unlike Historical, this makes no claim about age or a producer's real-time window. API access terms can be more restrictive than the licence on the resulting data and must be checked separately.

LICENSE_URL.description: URL of the licence or terms the field is offered under.

CITATION.description: Citation the upstream publisher asks for.

PRODUCER_PEER_ID.description: Peer identifier of the node that ingested and published this record.

TIME_BASIS.description:
Times published by the source; governs whether initialization, lead
and horizon are meaningful. The default preserves existing records.

Initialization.description: INIT_TIME_MS names a run; VALID_TIME_MS = INIT_TIME_MS + LEAD_HOURS * 3,600,000. This is the existing WXF convention.

ValidTimeOnly.description: Only VALID_TIME_MS is known. The source may blend runs or omit their initialization times. INIT_TIME_MS, LEAD_HOURS and HORIZON_HOURS MUST be omitted; their zero defaults do not mean a run in 1970, zero lead, or zero horizon. RETRIEVED_AT is not a substitute for initialization.

QUANTIZED_U16.description:
Inline 16-bit codes when VALUES_ENCODING is InlineQuantizedUint16,
GRID.NLAT * GRID.NLON in the order of VALUES.

QUANTIZED_U8.description:
Inline 8-bit codes when VALUES_ENCODING is InlineQuantizedUint8; the
encoded chunk when it is InlineEncodedChunk.

SCALE_FACTOR.description: Scale applied to a quantized code, in UNITS per code step.

ADD_OFFSET.description: Offset added after scaling a quantized code, in UNITS.

SENSOR_ID.description:
Instrument that observed the field: the platform and instrument
designation its operator publishes. Absent for model output.

CHANNEL_WAVELENGTH_UM.description:
Central wavelength of the channel the field was measured or retrieved
at, micrometres; 0 when not a single channel.

PLATFORM_LONGITUDE_DEG.description:
Geodetic longitude of the observing platform, degrees east (the
sub-satellite point of a geostationary imager), for viewing-geometry
and parallax corrections. NaN when unstated.

PLATFORM_LATITUDE_DEG.description:
Geodetic latitude of the observing platform, degrees north. NaN when
unstated.

PLATFORM_HEIGHT_M.description:
Height of the observing platform above the WGS84 ellipsoid, metres.
NaN when unstated.

SCAN_END_TIME_MS.description:
End of the observation's scan, Unix milliseconds UTC, when the samples
were taken over an interval; VALID_TIME_MS is then the scan start.
0 when unstated.
